name: Primary pill button
purpose: The site's single conversion affordance — a dark filled pill that always carries a forward arrow. Every 'Sign up for free' / 'Learn more' / 'Read docs' / 'View careers' CTA on the site is this one primitive.

iconTrailing.note: Not optional. Re-measured live and recorded in three separate component comments: every dark-filled pill carries a 12px forward arrow at a 12px gap; ghost pills carry none.

accessibility.focusVisible: inherits browser default; no custom focus ring in source
